prompt: Hibernate XML mapping node attribute dot period format
answer:
In Hibernate XML mapping, the `node` attribute supports these formats:

- `node="element-name"` — maps to the named XML element
- `node="@attribute-name"` — maps to the named XML attribute
- `node="."` — maps to the parent element
- `node="element-name/@attribute-name"` — maps to an attribute of the named element

Therefore, the dot (`.`) format means **map the property or entity data to the parent XML element**.
